event_corroboration.detail: No South American gauge checked. GloFAS discharge is the intended corroboration and is blocked on a licence acceptance.
event_corroboration.note: This channel's own instruments measure rainfall and flood extent. Neither establishes that a flood occurred, so this field carries evidence from outside them and is not derived from anything above.

instrument_coverage.note: the rainfall instrument holds data to 2026-08-28, past the window end of 2026-08-28, so this window is complete

series.units: mm, area mean over the region

guards: the baseline median is 3.44, below the provisional floor of 5.0. A multiple against a near-zero baseline amplifies noise rather than measuring an anomaly, so the x-median figure must not be quoted here however large it looks. The rank is unaffected by this guard

series.measures: standing water outside the reference water mask
not_assessed_reason: no flood-extent baseline has been built for this region, so the instrument's ability to see it is unknown and untested
series.not_assessed_summary: We have not measured flooding here. This page reports rainfall only.
